stem: What is the patient-safety purpose of continuing-competency requirements used by boards of nursing for license renewal or reinstatement?

options.A: To support assurance that nurses remain safe and competent to practice
options.B: To allow practice without regard to current competence
options.C: To replace all jurisdiction-specific licensure requirements with one federal rule
options.D: To guarantee employment after license renewal

rationale: NCSBN's Uniform Licensure Requirements frame continued licensure and reinstatement requirements around public protection and the expectation of safe, competent nursing practice.
educational_objective: Explain why continuing-competency requirements are connected to licensure renewal and public protection.
source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
source_locator: Renewal/Reinstatement requirements — safe and competent practice/public protection
source_claim_supported: Licensure renewal/reinstatement requirements are designed to support safe and competent nursing practice and public protection.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
blueprint_locator: Management of Care, printed p.7/PDF p.11
blueprint_topic: Management of Care — licensure and professional accountability
correction_summary: Replaced stale 2007 continuing-competency material with current NCSBN Uniform Licensure Requirements and removed a universal CE-hour claim.
